note: Trigger-accuracy regression suite. Same shape and run command as ../../recording-decisions/evals/README.md.

evals.name: gate-blocked-the-turn
evals.prompt: the strauss kb review gate just blocked my stop hook with a D5 and an A1. who's supposed to fix these — me right now, or does something else pick them up later?
evals.why: The tier-1 route, asked as the question this skill answers.

evals.name: stale-base-before-review
evals.prompt: i'm about to review PR 412 against its .strauss/kb but the author's session ended yesterday. how do i get the base into a state i can trust before i read it?
evals.why: A consumer's pre-flight with no author left: tier 3.

evals.name: spawn-a-fixer
evals.prompt: can something rebaseline the drifted anchors on this companion base in CI and file the rest as questions, without inventing decisions the author never made?
evals.why: The late fixer's one repair, and the mandate that stops it inventing a why.

evals.name: which-findings-are-mine
evals.prompt: kb-review-gate --report gives me eleven findings, some labelled mechanical and some semantic. which of these can a fixer actually apply and which have to go back to whoever wrote the code?
evals.why: Routing on `fixable`, which is what this skill reads.

evals.name: subagent-still-alive
evals.prompt: my implementation subagent wrote the kb records and it's still running in this session. the gate found problems with them — should i message it or fix them myself?
evals.why: Tier 2, and the condition that makes it available.

evals.name: walkthrough-refused
evals.prompt: the review walkthrough renderer exited 3 saying two records drifted. what's the right way to get past that — who repairs the base?
evals.why: A consumer refusing on an unfixed base routes here.

evals.name: semantic-gap-owner
evals.prompt: there's a hunk in this diff with no record covering it and the author is long gone. i don't want to guess why they changed it. what do i write instead?
evals.why: The semantic gap becoming an open question owned by the author.

evals.name: ci-preflight
evals.prompt: our merge job reads the companion kb before it decides whether a human has to look. what should it run first so it isn't reading records that no longer match the code?
evals.why: The pre-flight rule and the routing that follows it.

evals.name: may-a-fixer-write-a-decision
evals.prompt: is it ok for an automated fixer to write a kb decision on the author's behalf if it can tell from the diff what they chose?
evals.why: The prohibition that defines the late tier.

evals.name: reviewer-agent-findings
evals.prompt: the kb-reviewer agent came back with a pile of gate findings on a branch nobody's working on any more. what happens to them now?
evals.why: Handing a consumer's findings to a tier that can act on them.

evals.name: write-a-risk
evals.prompt: i just realised a retried checkout can charge twice. how do i record that as a risk in the kb so it shows up next to the hunk?
evals.why: Writing the base is review-companion.

evals.name: record-a-decision
evals.prompt: i picked exponential backoff over a fixed delay for the payment retry. should that be a kb_write_decision, and what goes in the alternative field?
evals.why: recording-decisions.

evals.name: do-the-review
evals.prompt: review this PR against its companion base and tell me which records actually survive reading the code.
evals.why: kb-review: judging the claims, not repairing the base.

evals.name: reading-order
evals.prompt: give me an html walkthrough of this pull request with the blocking risks first and deep links into the diff.
evals.why: review-walkthrough.

evals.name: fix-the-code
evals.prompt: the retry loop in base.repository.ts is wrong — five attempts with no jitter. fix the code.
evals.why: A code change; nothing to do with the base.

evals.name: arm-the-gate
evals.prompt: how do i turn the kb review gate on for this workspace, and how do i demote F4 to a warning?
evals.why: Arming and thresholds are the plugin README's.

evals.name: run-the-gate
evals.prompt: run the kb review gate on this branch and show me what it reports.
evals.why: Running the gate is the README's; this skill starts at the findings it hands back.

evals.name: kb-lookup
evals.prompt: does the knowledge base already say anything about how repositories retry transient store errors? i don't want to decide it twice.
evals.why: A base lookup, answered by knowledge-base.

evals.name: merge-conflict
evals.prompt: i rebased and now .strauss/kb/log.jsonl has conflict markers in it. how do i resolve that file?
evals.why: A git conflict in a bundle file, not a gate finding.

evals.name: prune-old-records
evals.prompt: the base has forty review-tagged records from merged PRs. how do i clear the resolved ones out?
evals.why: `sweep --tag review --terminal`; housekeeping, not routing a finding.
